visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Close-up shot of light-colored noodles being lifted by a hand. Thick brown mushroom sauce is poured over the noodles. The lighting is bright and even. (2) Medium shot of a black frying pan. A hand uses wooden chopsticks to place two cubes of yellow butter into the pan. (3) The butter melts and bubbles. A hand pours minced white garlic into the pan. (4) Sliced brown mushrooms are added to the pan from a glass bowl. (5) Diced white onions are poured into the pan over the cooked mushrooms. (6) White flour is sifted from a small container into the pan. The chef stirs the mixture with chopsticks. (7) Black pepper is sprinkled into the pan. Red ketchup and brown miso paste are added. The mixture is stirred into a thick paste. (8) Medium shot of a male chef in a white uniform and black apron. He stands in a kitchen studio with a blue background and a shelf. He gestures with his hands while talking. (9) Close-up of the finished brown mushroom sauce simmering and bubbling in a pot. (10) On a black griddle, a white egg is cracked and fried. Yellow noodles are placed next to it and stir-fried. (11) Thick mushroom sauce is poured over the noodles on the hot griddle. Steam rises from the food. (12) The final dish is presented on a black plate on a blue placemat. The noodles are coated in sauce with visible mushroom slices.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Upbeat acoustic guitar music with a steady drum beat begins. A male voice speaks energetically in Mandarin, introducing a noodle dish. (2) A crisp sizzling sound is heard as butter hits a pan, followed by the clinking of wooden chopsticks. (3) A percussive 'thud' accompanies garlic being added, followed by more intense sizzling. (4) The sizzling continues as mushrooms are added; the voice explains the high water content of mushrooms. (5) A sharp 'whoosh' transition sound leads to onions being added with a wet sizzling texture. (6) A soft 'dusty' sound effect marks the flour being sifted. The narrator's pitch rises to emphasize a 'secret tip'. (7) Liquid splashing sounds and rhythmic scraping of chopsticks occur as sauces are mixed. (8) The chef's direct speech is heard clearly over the music, with high articulation and a friendly tone. (9) A simmering, bubbly sound floor represents the sauce cooking. (10) A loud crack followed by a sharp sizzle of an egg on a griddle. (11) A heavy, loud steam sizzle erupts as sauce is poured onto hot noodles. The music swells in volume. (12) The music continues as the final dish is presented, ending with a clean chord.
